definition.view: Season (current-season completed games with a snap, excluding 0-snap DNPs). Bye weeks are not counted.
definition.clear: Over a half-line (24.5 → 25+) or ≥ an integer line. The board shows the HIGHEST qualifying rung, not the lowest.
definition.rungs: Posted alt lines and the published main line when we already have them; if no posted rung qualifies, standard increments (5 yards or 1 count) extend below so a true season floor can still show. No new odds pulls.
definition.threshold: Default 100% (cleared in every game). UI also offers 90, 80, and 75. Minimum 6 games played.
definition.parlay: 2–4 legs per game, best season rates then streak then higher rung. At most one correlated family per player (pass volume, rush volume, receiving volume, or rush+rec). Combined rate is the product of individual season rates and is not independent.
definition.injuries: Out, Doubtful, IR, inactive, and similar holds are dropped, including manual official Outs. Questionable stays.
definition.injury_exits: Game logs do not flag mid-game injury exits. 0-snap DNPs are excluded; unusually low snap share is noted in the narrative but still counted.

parlay.combined_note: Combined historical clear rate is the product of each leg's season rate. Legs are not independent (same game, and often the same script).
parlay.price_note: No full parlay price: at least one rung has no listed book price (often an alt below the main line).
